Disappointing Picnic Experience with Allen Coaching Classes

I recently attended the Allen Coaching Classes picnic at Imagica, and unfortunately, it was a disappointing experience. The decision to bring the entire Mumbai branch together for a picnic was not well thought out.

The park was overcrowded, and the students, including myself, were not able to enjoy the rides and attractions due to the long wait times. It felt like we were stuck in a never-ending queue 😐.
Considering the large number of students, it would have been better if Allen Coaching Classes had organized branch-wise picnics. This would have allowed students to have a more enjoyable and relaxed experience.

I hope Allen Coaching Classes will take this feedback into consideration for future events.

Suggestions:
Organize branch-wise picnics to avoid overcrowding.
Choose a less crowded venue or a private event space.
Plan activities and games that can be enjoyed by all students, even in a crowded environment. 👍
